notes: Philippine payroll rates effective 2026-01-01. Every figure below must be checked against the primary source before production use. Fields marked verify:false have NOT been confirmed against an official table.

sss.note: MSC is a stepped bracket, not a percentage of salary. Salary is mapped to the nearest MSC step. Above mpfThreshold the excess portion is routed to the Mandatory Provident Fund, but the employee's total 5% share is unchanged.

philhealth.note: Continuous, not stepped. Premium is computed on basic monthly salary clamped between floor and ceiling.

pagibig.note: 1% for monthly compensation of 1500 or below, 2% above. Compensation is capped at salaryCap, so the employee share maxes at 200.

withholding.source: BIR Revised Withholding Tax Table, TRAIN, 2023 onward
withholding.note: Period brackets as published by the BIR. These are NOT annual brackets divided by period count -- the BIR publishes rounded boundaries and base amounts, and payroll systems use the published figures. Using annual/12 instead produces centavo-level differences from a real payslip.

thirteenthMonth.note: 13th month pay plus other benefits are tax-exempt up to this combined annual ceiling.
